create_habitat_env: create a Habitat Env instance with a DictConfig and optional Dataset for embodied AI simulation
reset_env_episode: reset the Env to start a new episode and return initial observations from the simulator
step_env_action: step the Env by performing an action and return observations after the action is executed
create_rl_env: create an RLEnv subclass that wraps Env with gym.Env interface for reinforcement learning training
get_env_metrics: get the current episode metrics from the Env task measurements system
